endcard-the_flame.title: You are...
endcard-the_flame.sharePrompt: Share your End card on social now!

identity.title: Core Identity
identity.desc: You are a driving force fueled by the fire of justice. You do not see injustice as a mere problem, but as an enemy that must be confronted head-on. When others hesitate, you are the first to step onto the front lines. Your spirit ignites at the sight of oppression, and you believe that silence is a form of surrender.
identity.question: “What must be challenged?”
identity.questionDesc: You constantly seek out unjust power structures and are always ready to shake them.
identity.idealWorldDesc: A world where injustice is met with courage—no compromise, no waiting. Everyone should dare to rise and fight for what is right.

element.title: Element
element.name: Fire
element.desc: the power of change, passion, and truth that burns away the ephemeral

superpower.title: Superpower
superpower.subTitle: Superpower
superpower.name: Ignition Aura
superpower.desc: An ember of emotions burning bright with a fiery core, ready to ignite justice and encourage people to fight against evil. This power is more than words—it is an aura of energy radiating from you, awakening courage and pushing those who hesitate to choose to fight alongside you

strengths.title: Strengths
strengths.deliveryDesc: Bold and charismatic, able to inspire and lead with confidence.
strengths.deliveryEx: At a rally where morale is fading, you can grab the microphone and reignite the crowd’s energy with just a few fiery words.
strengths.braveDesc: Unafraid to ask the questions no one dares to ask, or to challenge those in power publicly.
strengths.fastDesc: In moments of crisis, you act instinctively and decisively, often creating waves of change.

growth.title: Growth Edge
growth.weaknessDesc: Your quick-to-action perk can lead to unexpected victories, but it can also derail team plans due to poor communication.
growth.weaknessEx: You may suddenly change a protest route without consulting the team, causing support units with supplies to go to the wrong place.
growth.adviceDesc: Your power is immense, but it is strongest when directed. Partner with Architect so your actions are backed by a plan—turning wild fire into a sharp laser.

alliance.title: Alliance
alliance.architectDesc: You are the frontline; Architect provides the blueprint and points out weak spots. They ensure that your attack is not only brave but also smart.
alliance.sparkDesc: You light the fire; Spark pours fuel on it. You ignite a hot topic, and The Spark makes it go viral overnight.
alliance.guardianDesc: Your impulsiveness may worry Guardian, who prioritises safety and may constantly try to hold you back, creating tension in timing.
alliance.seederDesc: You demand immediate change, while Seeder believes in slow growth. You may see them as inactive, and they may see you as going against the foundations they have built.

environment.title: Ideal Environment
environment.shineDesc: frontline protests and marches, fast-paced campaigns, acting as a voice during crises, and debating to defend ideals.
environment.questionDesc: What form of injustice ignites your fire the most—and how will you control that fire so it does not burn you or your allies?

role.title: Roles & Careers in Movements
role.name: The Flame
role.desc: typically takes frontline roles where courage, urgency, and mobilisation are key.
list: • Direct action coordinator (environment, labour, or human rights)
• Spokesperson / public speaker for high-profile issues
• Community mobiliser in conflict or resistance areas

endcard-the_architect.title: You are...
endcard-the_architect.sharePrompt: Share your End card on social now!

identity.title: Core Identity
identity.desc: You are the brain of the team. You see the big picture, analyse patterns, and design complex plans for real systemic change. You believe not in luck, but in well-crafted strategy.
identity.question: “What is the most effective system?”
identity.questionDesc: You seek weaknesses in existing systems and design better ones.
identity.idealWorldDesc: A world of transparent, efficient systems that serve humanity—not the other way around.

element.title: Element
element.name: Metal
element.desc: clarity, strength, and structure. Like a blade or steel framework defining direction and limits

superpower.title: Superpower
superpower.subTitle: Superpower
superpower.name: Blueprint Core
superpower.desc: A system capable of simulating and solving any complicated matters in real-time, constructing a blueprint to accurately predict the unknown future. This power assists you in seeing variables and paths others miss.

strengths.title: Strengths
strengths.strategyDesc: Systematic thinking and long-term planning excellence.
strengths.strategyEx: While others are debate, you have already outlined a five-step action plan with contingencies A, B, and C.
strengths.logicDesc: Decisions based on analysis—not emotion, making them reliable and highly-succeeding.

growth.title: Growth Edge
growth.weaknessEx: You refine a plan so long that you miss the best moment to act.
growth.adviceDesc: The best plan is one that begins. The Flame’s momentum can help launch plans and projects that may have yet to be perfect. Trust your ability to adapt.

alliance.title: Alliance
alliance.guardianDesc: Executes your well-crafted plans safely and carefully.
alliance.flameDesc: Provides the push that turns plans on paper into action on the field.
alliance.echoDesc: You may see them as emotional and biased; they may see you as inhuman and cold.
alliance.sparkDesc: Their improvisation feels unpredictable to you, causing you to deeply worry if things will go south.

environment.title: Ideal Environment
environment.shineDesc: strategic planning, system design, data analysis, complex project management, and advisory roles.
environment.questionDesc: What is the most inefficient system you encounter daily—and what is the first step in drafting a new blueprint for it?

role.title: Roles & Careers in Movements
role.name: The Architect
role.desc: is essential for structure, foresight, and planning.

endcard-the_spark.title: You are...
endcard-the_spark.sharePrompt: Share your End card on social now!

identity.title: Core Identity
identity.desc: You are the energy that creates momentum. With charm and creativity, you turn ideas viral overnight. You believe change doesn’t always have to be serious; it can be fun, colourful, and widely accessible.
identity.question: “What can we spark?”
identity.questionDesc:
You seek the right idea and perfect timing to
 create momentum.
identity.idealWorldDesc:
A world where powerful ideas spread like wildfire, 
driving movements and change in an instant.

element.title: Element
element.name: Wind & Lightning
element.desc: movement, connection, rapid spread; combined with Electricity — instant activation and ignition

superpower.title: Superpower
superpower.subTitle: Superpower
superpower.name: Viral Lightning
superpower.desc: A loud, flashy spark thundering in the sky with its dazzling power, shining with an aura that draws a mass of attention to itself. This power is majors in catching trends and creating the right content at the right moment, triggering massive sharing.

strengths.title: Strengths
strengths.influenceDesc: Highly energetic and connective; excites and motivates teams.
strengths.influenceEx: You turn a boring issue into a TikTok challenge or a sharp meme that goes viral.
strengths.adaptDesc: You understand online culture and pivot strategies quickly.
strengths.creativeDesc: Overflowing with fresh ideas and engaging presentation styles.

growth.title: Growth Edge
growth.weaknessDesc: High energy may lead to shallow execution.
growth.weaknessEx: You jump into new ideas enthusiastically but abandon them once attention arrives, causing them to be inconsistent.
growth.adviceDesc: You ignite the spark, but someone must tend it. Lean on Architect to give structure so your creativity leads to lasting and sustainable impact.

alliance.title: Alliance
alliance.flameDesc: Provides raw, authentic issues as a fuel to go viral. The Flame creates meaning; you turn it into reach.
alliance.architectDesc: Turns online buzz into real-world change with a systematic movement and strategy.
alliance.seederDesc: You may see them as slow and tedious; they may see you as superficial.
alliance.guardianDesc: Your chaos clashes with their need for order, which may cause you to feel uneasy.

environment.title: Ideal Environment
environment.shineDesc: social media campaigns, branding, events, flash mobs, online networking and mobilisation.
environment.questionDesc: What idea do you believe in enough to make it go viral—and how will you protect its core meaning?

role.title: Roles & Careers in Movements
role.name: The Spark
role.desc: is vital for communication strategy and mass awareness.

endcard-the_echo.title: You are...
endcard-the_echo.sharePrompt: Share your End card on social now!

identity.title: Core Identity
identity.desc: You transform information into emotion. Through storytelling, you connect hearts and turn complex issues into human narratives. You believe statistics and data alone cannot change the world without stories that reflect humanity.
identity.question: “What truth has not yet been told?”
identity.questionDesc: You seek silenced voices and hidden stories.
identity.idealWorldDesc: A world where empathy is a common language and every story is honoured and heard equally.

element.title: Element
element.name: Aether
element.desc: space, memory, and the unseen, a subtle dimension beyond direct touch

superpower.title: Superpower
superpower.subTitle: Superpower
superpower.name: Resonance Thread
superpower.desc: A magic spell that weaves all stories with people’s hearts, embracing sorrow and grief to tailor a shining hope anew. You find the “heart” of every issue and make it feel personal.

strengths.title: Strengths
strengths.narrativeDesc: Deep emotional insight and compelling storytelling.
strengths.narrativeEx: Instead of citing homelessness statistics or raw data, you tell one person’s story, creating greater emotional impact than hundreds of data points.
strengths.empathyDesc: You make distant, complex issues feel personal.
strengths.listenerDesc: You listen to others not with your ears, but your heart, so people trust you and open up to you.

growth.title: Growth Edge
growth.weaknessDesc: You may focus so deeply on stories that execution is neglected.
growth.weaknessEx: You craft a powerful story but don’t plan how it will drive concrete change.
growth.adviceDesc: Your stories are your greatest weapon. Partner with The Architect to build strategy and impact upon the real world.

alliance.title: Alliance
alliance.seederDesc: You amplify their quiet work; they provide you with a stable space for your creative work.
alliance.guardianDesc: Provides emotional safety so you can tell fragile stories fully; you help tend to the team’s emotional wounds.
alliance.architectDesc: You may see them as cold and overly statistical; they may see you as overly emotional.
alliance.flameDesc: Your nuance may clash with their bluntness, resulting in miscommunication.

environment.title: Ideal Environment
environment.shineDesc: speechwriting, documentaries, in-depth interviews, art therapy, and story-driven branding.
environment.questionDesc: Whose story in society has never been heard—and how will you make it resonate?

role.title: Roles & Careers in Movements
role.name: The Echo
role.desc: drives change through narrative and communication.

endcard-the_guardian.title: You are...
endcard-the_guardian.sharePrompt: Share your End card on social now!

identity.title: Core Identity
identity.desc: You are the armour of the movement—defined by responsibility and sacrifice. You believe real change cannot happen if people do not feel safe. You tend to wounds
identity.question: “Who needs protection?”
identity.questionDesc: You always look for the most vulnerable and reach out to them first.
identity.idealWorldDesc: A world where everyone feels safe, physically and emotionally, and where the most vulnerable are cared for first.

element.title: Element
element.name: Water
element.desc: nurturing, soothing, and healing. It flows around obstacles, absorbs impact, and creates safe spaces.

superpower.title: Superpower
superpower.subTitle: Superpower
superpower.name: Safeguard Barrier
superpower.desc: A strong barrier that is able to repel every threat, protecting all that matters whether people, spaces, or emotions. It may appear as a visible energy shield or as a pervasive sense of safety and trust.

strengths.title: Strengths
strengths.safeguardDesc: Reliable and highly responsible; a pillar of safety.
strengths.safeguardEx: During intense internal conflict, you step in as mediator, setting ground rules so the conversation can resume peacefully.
strengths.calmDesc: While others panic, you stay composed and think systematically, being the team’s anchor.
strengths.loyalDesc: You will never betray your team or ideals and will protect them to the end.

growth.title: Growth Edge
growth.weaknessDesc: Excessive focus on safety may lead you to reject high-risk, high-reward plans.
growth.weaknessEx: You may oppose the Flame’s infiltration plan, even if it’s the only chance of success, because it feels too dangerous.
growth.adviceDesc: Safety matters, but so does growth. Trust the Architect’s plan and your teammates’ abilities. Let them take risks while you stand ready as the strongest backup.

alliance.title: Alliance
alliance.seederDesc: You protect the seedlings the Seeder plants, making long-term growth possible.
alliance.architectDesc: You ensure the Architect’s complex plans are executed safely and solidly.
alliance.flameDesc: You may see the Flame as reckless; the Flame may see you as fearful. Balance courage and safety.
alliance.sparkDesc: You value order and routine; Spark thrives on chaos and novelty, which you may see as unnecessary risks.

environment.title: Ideal Environment
environment.shineDesc: risk management, crowd safety, emotional support, and emergency preparedness.
environment.questionDesc: Who in your team feels most vulnerable right now, and how can you create a truly safe space for them?

role.title: Roles & Careers in Movements
role.name: The Guardian
role.desc: often works behind the scenes, focused on care, security, and stability.
list: • Security coordinator for human rights defenders
• Social worker supporting survivors (sexual violence, refugees, torture survivors)
• HR/operations roles focused on organisational safety culture

endcard-the_seeder.title: You are...
endcard-the_seeder.sharePrompt: Share your End card on social now!

identity.title: Core Identity
identity.desc: You are a change-maker who believes in slow, steady growth like a great tree. You avoid flashy wins and instead build strong foundations for future generations. Your patience and dedication quietly support everyone’s success.
identity.question: “What needs to be cultivated?”
identity.questionDesc: You search for hidden potential and nurture it over time.
identity.idealWorldDesc: A self-renewing society where healing, care, and sustainability matter more than quick fixes.

element.title: Element
element.name: Earth
element.desc: foundation, solidity, stability. Combined with Wood — growth, branching, and regeneration

superpower.title: Superpower
superpower.subTitle: Superpower
superpower.name: Sprout Sparkle
superpower.desc: A small seed holding vast growth potential, sprouting into a tiny sapling that blooms a new opportunity for future. The impact isn’t immediate, but it plants change that spreads across the world over time.

strengths.title: Strengths
strengths.cohesionDesc: Patient and detail-oriented; builds strong foundations through wise resource use.
strengths.cohesionEx: While others plan protests, you build support networks, secure supplies, and form community relationships for long-term sustainability.
strengths.visionDesc: You understand that real change takes time and remain steady despite setbacks.
strengths.unityDesc: You bring diverse talents together into effective collaboration.

growth.title: Growth Edge
growth.weaknessDesc: Discomfort with confrontation may cause hesitation in necessary moments.
growth.weaknessEx: You may notice a team problem but stay silent to avoid conflict, allowing it to worsen later.
growth.adviceDesc: Your calm is a strength, but confrontation is sometimes necessary. Let the Echo help communicate sensitive issues, or allow the Flame to confront while you support from behind.

alliance.title: Alliance
alliance.guardianDesc: Protects the foundations you build from storms of threats and attacks.
alliance.echoDesc: Amplifies your quiet work, helping the world see its value.
alliance.flameDesc: You may see the Flame as shortsighted; the Flame may see you as too slow and tedious.
alliance.sparkDesc: You prioritise depth and sustainability; Spark prioritises speed and trends, which may cause a contrast in workflow.

environment.title: Ideal Environment
environment.shineDesc: community development, long-term planning, organisational culture-building, sustainable resource management, and mentorship.
environment.questionDesc: What “seed of change” are you planting right now—and what kind of water, soil, and sunlight does it need to grow strong?

role.title: Roles & Careers in Movements
role.name: The Seeder
role.desc: works in long-term vision, education, and foundational initiatives.
list: • Campaign researcher (long-term issues such as death penalty or refugee rights)
• NGO worker in environment or development
